en: So you made it. Seven of Kanto's Badges, and a Johto Champion's title on top. You've been busy.
I was the Champion once, you know. For about five minutes. Then someone from Pallet Town beat me.
I won't lose that easily again. Let's see what you've got!
Tch. You're the real thing, all right. Here, take it: the Earth Badge.
{player} received the Earth Badge from Blue!
And this. It's a strange move, but in the right hands it turns a battle on its head.
TM92 is Trick Room. For five turns, the slowest Pokémon move first.
That's all sixteen Badges, isn't it? If you're heading for Mt. Silver, say hello to someone for me.
Hey, champ in the making! Blue doesn't stick to one type. Bring a team that can handle anything.
You beat Blue! I knew you had it in you.

Viridian City Pokémon Gym
Leader: Blue
